decisions.reason: This newly launched product line with several models builds on the firm's core automation offer and is central to its announced direction of automated precast production, so the firm's heavy investment and visible commitment favor persisting with it even if early sales are slow.

The production analysis software was launched only in 2024, costs little to maintain, and supports the firm's integrated lifecycle and digitalization strategy, so weak early results would likely be attributed to a temporary market ramp-up rather than prompt withdrawal.
